POLICE_WRONGFUL_DETENTION.name: Police Wrongful Detention / Unlawful Stop
POLICE_WRONGFUL_DETENTION.description: Police stopped or detained you without legal grounds, warrant, or reasonable suspicion
scenario_examples: Detained for just walking in public
Stopped and asked personal questions without suspicion

POLICE_HARASSMENT_VERBAL.name: Police Verbal Harassment / Misconduct
POLICE_HARASSMENT_VERBAL.description: Police used abusive language, disrespectful behavior, or threats
scenario_examples: Police used bad language toward me

POLICE_INVASION_PRIVACY.name: Police Privacy Violation / Illegal Search
POLICE_INVASION_PRIVACY.description: Police searched body or personal items without consent or legal authority

UNLAWFUL_QUESTIONING_MINORS.name: Police Questioning of Minors / Vulnerable Persons
UNLAWFUL_QUESTIONING_MINORS.description: Police questioned or detained you (or minor) without parent/guardian present
scenario_examples: Police questioned my daughter without parents present
Police called parents after detaining a minor
Child kept at station without guardian

FREEDOM_MOVEMENT.name: Freedom of Movement Restriction
FREEDOM_MOVEMENT.description: Police or authority restricted your right to move freely in public spaces
scenario_examples: Not allowed to move in public area
Asked why I was with someone

HARASSMENT_COUPLE.name: Harassment of Couple / Adults in Public
HARASSMENT_COUPLE.description: Police harassed or questioned couple/adults for being together in public
scenario_examples: Police asked why we were together
Told adults they shouldn't be in public together

THREAT_INTIMIDATION_BY_POLICE.name: Threat / Intimidation by Police
THREAT_INTIMIDATION_BY_POLICE.description: Police made threats of violence, arrest without cause, or intimidated you
scenario_examples: Police threatened to arrest without reason

CYBER_FRAUD_SCAM.name: Cyber Fraud / Online Scam
CYBER_FRAUD_SCAM.description: You received fraudulent communication, hacked account, or online scam

WARRANT_CLARIFICATION.name: Warrant / Legal Authority Verification
WARRANT_CLARIFICATION.description: Police claims to have warrant or legal authority, you want to verify
scenario_examples: Police says they have a warrant
